definition: הֶ֫רֶס noun [masculine] overthrow, destruction , only Isa 19:18 one shall be called עִיר הַהֶרֶס city of destruction , i.e. (as usually explained) with punning allusion to On-Heliopolis: it shall be called no longer עַיר הַחֶרֶס city of the sun , but עיר ההרס city of destruction , city whose temples, etc., of the sun have been destroyed; but perhaps < ᵐ5 πόλις ασεδεκ = עִיר הֵצֶּדֶק city of righteousness , so Gei Urschrift 79 Brd Di (change intentional ? compare id.); on other views see id. & De Che .

הֶ֫רֶס noun [masculine] overthrow, destruction, only Isa 19:18 one shall be called עִיר הַהֶרֶס city of destruction, i.e. (as usually explained) with punning allusion to On-Heliopolis: it shall be called no longer עַיר הַחֶרֶס city of the sun, but עיר ההרס city of destruction, city whose temples, etc., of the sun have been destroyed; but perhaps < ᵐ5 πόλις ασεδεκ = עִיר הֵצֶּדֶק city of righteousness, so GeiUrschrift 79 Brd Di (change intentional ? compare id.); on other views see id. & De Che.
